content.text: Selected HumbleBeeAI research spans real-time multi-object tracking, contextual receptivity prediction, network intrusion detection, and medical-image classification. The entries below retain the reported findings and publication status for review as part of the company portfolio.

LITE: A Paradigm Shift in Multi-Object Tracking with Efficient ReID Feature Integration — DeepSORT+LITE reports HOTA 43.03 at 28.3 FPS on MOT17, with lower appearance-feature overhead than a separate ReID model. arXiv preprint v2, 1 October 2024.

content.text: Design of Contextual Filtered Features for Better Smartphone-User Receptivity Prediction — Reports average ROC-AUC of 56.5% versus 54.7% for conventional features on KEmoPhone data (3,334 responses from 73 participants over one week). Published, IEEE Internet of Things Journal 11(7), 1 April 2024; listing says 2023.

content.text: Investigating the Effect of Traffic Sampling on Machine Learning-Based Network Intrusion Detection Approaches — Finds that short malicious flows may be missed even at sampling rates of 1/10 and 1/100; random forest with SketchFlow provides a favorable detection/false-alarm balance in evaluated settings. Published online 23 December 2021; IEEE Access vol. 10, 2022.

TABLE 2. Evaluation framework of previous studies are compared. Criteria for inclusion is (1) studies with high citation and/or studies which used same dataset (i.e., CIC-IDS-2018) with our work. We improve previous ML-based NIDS by (1) showing better ML performance through data imbalance handling, (2) employ fair overall metric for comparison by using Macro averaging and (3) most importantly provide evaluation framework for NIDS in the presence of sampling by introducing flow level metric.
